description: Codex mid-turn, printing a reply to a message the user sent while it worked. Codex hides its 'Working (… • esc to interrupt)' row while that message prints, so the current frame shows only a new bullet message above the input, with no 'Worked for …' line closing the turn; the earlier frames show the Working row. The model reads this as a finished turn (idle) even when told about the hidden row, so a long Codex turn flapped to idle every time it printed a mid-turn message. Codex's own rollout still has the turn open (task_started with no task_complete), which `turn_live` replays as the watcher reads it: the turn is running.
